text:
🐾 IT’S OFFICIAL, Tzu Crew! 🐾

Our first BeanTown Tzu Crew meetup is happening! 🤎🐶

Come let your Shih Tzu make some new friends, get some zoomies out, and meet other Boston-area Tzu parents.

📍 Peter’s Park Dog Park, South End
📅 Sunday, November 1, 2026
⏰ 12:00–2:00 PM

All Shih Tzus are welcome! Big personalities, tiny paws, fluffy coats, and all. 🐾

Tag your Tzu bestie and share this with your fellow Boston Shih Tzu parents. We can’t wait to meet you and your floof! 🤎

#BeanTownTzuCrew #BostonShihTzu #BostonDogs #ShihTzuBoston #BostonDogCommunity
